items.headline: US Forces Strike Iranian Launchers on Larak Island
items.summary: On Sunday, United States forces carried out strikes against two Iranian rocket launchers located on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz. American officials stated the targeted forces were preparing to deploy sea mines into the strategic shipping route, marking the first acknowledged US strike on Iranian targets in nearly a month.

items.headline: NASA Launches $4.3 Billion Roman Space Telescope to Explore Dark Energy and Exoplanets
items.summary: On August 30, 2026, NASA successfully launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The flagship observatory is traveling 1.5 million kilometers to Lagrange Point 2 to survey dark energy, dark matter, and thousands of new exoplanets.

items.summary: The 2026 US Open officially began at Flushing Meadows on August 30, launching the final Grand Slam tennis tournament of the year. Opening-day action saw third seed Jessica Pegula and former champion Daniil Medvedev secure straight-set victories to advance to the second round.

items.headline: Shelved 'Coyote vs. Acme' Scores $15.5 Million Box Office Comeback
items.summary: After being famously shelved by Warner Bros. for a tax write-off, the Looney Tunes movie Coyote vs. Acme finally premiered in theaters and earned $15.5 million to secure second place at the weekend box office. The strong debut and high audience scores mark a rare theatrical triumph for a project that was nearly erased from public release.
